objective: Port the OpenClaw hybrid retrieval core (C8, C10), about 1.1k lines of TypeScript, MIT. This gives the Grok-like "chat over your documents": every answer names its file and line, and an uncited answer is refused. It uses the SQLite and FTS5 bundled with Node 24.14.1, checked on 2026-11-01, so it adds no dependency. Keyword search ships here; the vector seam is left unfilled because embeddings would need a paid provider and sqlite-vec is added only when that phase is approved.
